description: Master (golden) HCP identifier; primary key used by every other bronze file.
constraints: PK; unique; not null; pattern HCP[0-9]{6}

description: Primary practice specialty; drives topic relevance and product affinity.
Sales region of record; joins to market_factors.region.
Commercial value segment derived from latent patient opportunity (noisy, not deterministic).
1 = actively targeted/prescribing, 0 = inactive. Inactive HCPs show materially lower activity and Rx.
Speaker program identifier.
constraints: PK; unique; not null; pattern EV[0-9]{4}

description: Scheduled event date (ISO-8601). Historical events 2024-09..2026-05; Planned events are future-dated.
constraints: YYYY-MM-DD; not null; Planned rows > run date

description: Therapeutic topic; maps 1:1 to the promoted product (mapping is NOT exposed in bronze).
Delivery format; drives cost, travel friction and effect size.
Synthetic speaker identifier; speakers specialise by therapeutic area.
Lifecycle status. ONLY 'Completed' constitutes treatment exposure.
Invited-to event.
Invited HCP.
Date the invitation was issued.
constraints: YYYY-MM-DD; must be <= events.date for the same event_id

description: Channel the invitation was delivered through; sets the invite lead time.
Dominant targeting driver recorded by the invitation engine.
constraints: Enum(6): Specialty match|Product affinity|Geographic proximity|Prior engagement|Patient-volume threshold|Combination of factors

description: Event the sign-in record belongs to.
constraints: FK -> events.event_id; (event_id,hcp_id) must exist in event_invitations

description: HCP the sign-in record belongs to.
1 = HCP registered for the program, 0 = tracked response without registration (declined/no action).
1 = attendance verified at the event, 0 = registered but did not attend.
Verified minutes present. 0 when verified_attended = 0.
Engagement score for the session. 0 when verified_attended = 0.
Prescribing HCP.
Calendar month of the prescription counts.
Portfolio product.
New prescriptions written in the month (NegativeBinomial draw).
Total prescriptions (new + refills) in the month.
Total prescriptions for competing molecules in the class.
Targeted HCP.
Month of activity, stamped to the first of the month (monthly aggregate grain).
Sales-rep detail calls in the month. Confounds both Rx and attendance.
Marketing emails delivered in the month.
Sample units dropped in the month.
Non-speaker-program touchpoints (congresses, advisory boards) in the month.
Costed event.
constraints: PK; unique; FK -> events.event_id; one row per event

description: Speaker honorarium paid.
Venue / streaming-platform cost.
Compliant meal spend.
Speaker and attendee travel/lodging.
Agency/logistics fees.
Total program cost. Sole cost input to the downstream ROI denominator.
constraints: = honorarium+venue+meal+travel+agency (exact); ~2% of rows are 3-5x format norm

description: Sales region.
Calendar month.
constraints: YYYY-MM; PK part 2; spans the full Rx panel

description: Formulary/payer access index for the region-month.
Multiplicative seasonality index centred on 1.0.
Competitive pressure index; >1 = above-normal pressure (staggered competitor entry).
Golden record ID; equals hcp_master.hcp_id.
constraints: PK; unique; FK -> hcp_master.hcp_id; one row per HCP

description: CRM system identifier (independent numbering).
Event/meeting-management system identifier.
constraints: Unique when present; NULL for ~2% of rows (unresolved event identity)

description: Prescription data vendor identifier.
constraints: Unique when present; NULL for ~3% of rows (unresolved Rx identity)

description: Identity resolution outcome. 'review' rows must be QUARANTINED downstream - never silently treated as non-attendees.
constraints: Enum(2): verified(~95%)|review(~5%); 'review' iff an ID is NULL

description: Portfolio product.
Financial scenario.
Expected number of dispensed fills generated by one new Rx.
Net contribution (USD) per dispensed fill.
Net contribution per incremental NRx. THE ONLY financial multiplier permitted downstream.
Completed event that generated the exposure.
Verified attendee.
HIDDEN TRUTH: total incremental NRx caused by this event for this HCP, summed over post-months +1..+3 (weights 0.45/0.33/0.22). Can be negative.
constraints: Real; NEVER a model input; absent rows = zero true effect

description: HIDDEN TRUTH: matching total incremental TRx over post-months +1..+3.
